content: {"praised":["Strong performances by Michael Dunn, Simone Signoret, Oskar Werner.","Classic film recognized by NY Times as a masterpiece.","Engaging characters with emotional depth and humanity.","Graceful, thoughtful tone throughout the story.","Excellent themes about human folly and destiny."],"criticized":["Pallid, plodding, tepid pacing.","Over-obvious and overlong narrative.","Story feels forced and uneven.","Tone too heavy and slow.","Some scenes forced to watch beyond two-thirds."]}
